title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Romans 12: the living sacrifice, the renewed mind, gifts in one body, and overcoming evil with good.

questions.text: What are the brothers urged to present as a living sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:1 urges them by the mercies of God to present their bodies a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God.

questions.text: By what are they to be transformed instead of being conformed to this world?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:2 says not to be conformed to this world, but to be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

questions.text: How is each person told to think of himself?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:3 says not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

answers.text: As the least of all creatures
Not more highly than he ought, but reasonably

questions.text: What are the many said to be in Christ?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:4-5 say that as we have many members in one body, so we who are many are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.

questions.text: With what should the one who shows mercy do it?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:8 says that he who shows mercy should do it with cheerfulness.
Romans 12:9 says to let love be without hypocrisy, to abhor what is evil and cling to what is good.

questions.text: What are they told to do to those who persecute them?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:14 says to bless those who persecute you, to bless and not curse.

questions.text: What follows “Rejoice with those who rejoice”?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:15 says, “Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.”

answers.text: “Be silent with those who are silent.”

questions.explanation: Romans 12:19 says not to seek revenge but to give place to God's wrath, for it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

answers.text: “An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.”
“Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
“The sword will not depart from his house.”

questions.text: How does the chapter say evil is to be overcome?
questions.explanation: Romans 12:21 says not to be overcome by evil, but to overcome evil with good.
